say:1:1123653001:1.text: The terrabirds ran away earlier? ... Don't the Grimmaw Clan have beast tamers?
say:1:1123653001:1.source_cn: 哈？小陆行鸟跑出来了？\n……黑嚎的人不懂驯兽吗？

say:2:1123653002:1.text: Anyway, you can just leave the birds to me. I'm a bird-taming expert. As long as I have this <style="highlight">whistle</style>...
say:2:1123653002:1.source_cn: 算了算了，这些鸟交给我就放心吧，我可是驯鸟好手！只要有...

say:3:1123653003:1.text: ... Wait a minute. Where's my <style="highlight">whistle</style>? It was in my bag just now!

say:4:1123653004:1.text: The Grimmaw Clan is going to be here any minute! Don't just stand there! Hurry up and help me look for my whistle!
say:4:1123653004:1.source_cn: 黑嚎的人马上就到了！你也别愣着，赶紧帮我一起找吧！
say:4:1123653004:1.male: The Grimmaw Clan is going to be here any minute! Don't just stand there! Hurry up and help me look for my whistle!
